text.p: * Romania has an overall 17,253,093 voters for November 3 general elections in 15,117 polling stations, judge Costica Ionescu, chairman of the Central Electoral Bureau told a news conference.
* A total of 43 parties and 6 alliances registered candidates for the general elections.

* U.S. President Bill Clinton is expected to make statement on Tuesday, naming the countries -- other than Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic -- which will get U.S. support in their bid to join NATO in a first wave of admissions.
* Transport and courier companies Tarom, Romtrans and DHL will deliver the voting ballots for some 230,000 voters outside Romania.

* Journalists, analysts and representatives of Romania's Intelligence Service launched the "White Book of Securitate Secret Police" which comprises reports to the former communist secret police on the country's artistic elite.
* Some 2,400 apartments were already sold in Bucharest from an overall 65,000 which can be acquired by former owners or tenants under a house restitution law.
* The national railway authority is willing to transport diesel oil required for the autumn farming works, the transport ministry said in a statement.
* National Unity Party (PUNR) vice-president Emil Pop has resigned and quit the party. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
